description: Defines the class TemplateDynamicenum, a specialization of TemplateEnum, for handling dynamic enumeration fields in the SuiteCRM platform. Contains methods for retrieving field definitions and rendering edit templates for dynamic enum fields.

classes.name: TemplateDynamicenum
classes.description: A class representing a dynamic enumeration field in SuiteCRM, extending the base TemplateEnum class with additional behavior specific to dynamic enum handling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of TemplateDynamicenum and maps the 'parentenum' property to 'ext2'.

methods.name: get_field_def
methods.description: Retrieves the field definition array, setting the database type to 'enum' and determining the parent enum source.

methods.name: get_xtpl_edit
methods.description: Generates an array of template variables for rendering the edit view of this dynamic enum field, including value, help text, and options.
